Interface MemoryLifecycleManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
RouxEngine
public interface MemoryLifecycleManager
The MemoryLifecycleManager is the call set for snapshots and shutdown. createAtomicSnapshot(SnapshotOptions, String) does not create a snapshot. restoreSnapshot(SnapshotHandle) refuses the restore. exportHeapDump(Path) refuses the export. shutdown(boolean) closes every open region. A pin does not stop shutdown. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MemoryLifecycleManager roux-design.md

    • restoreSnapshot

      OperationResult restoreSnapshot(SnapshotHandle handle)
      The method refuses to restore a snapshot. The refusal status is OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED.
      Parameters:
      handle - The handle is the snapshot to restore.
      Returns:
      The result is a failure.

    • exportHeapDump

      OperationResult exportHeapDump(Path destinationPath)
      The method refuses to export a heap dump. The refusal status is OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED.
      Parameters:
      destinationPath - The path is the file the dump would have used.
      Returns:
      The result is a failure.

    • shutdown

      void shutdown(boolean forceUnmap)
      The method closes every open region. A pin does not stop the close.
      Parameters:
      forceUnmap - The flag asks for a close that ignores pins.
